title: Confidence Calibration of Strong Models Under Weak Supervision: Does Weak Oversight Miscalibrate Student Confidence?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: weak supervision may cause miscalibrated confidence, miscalibration leads to deployment harm when models are confidently wrong in overseer blind spots. Direct connection to a known safety risk factor.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training models under both weak and strong supervision and measuring calibration. Setting up the weak/strong supervision pipeline and calibration metrics is moderate complexity. Doable with guidance on medium compute but not trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires two training runs (weak and strong supervision), defining overseer-unreliable held-out examples, and calibration measurement. Multiple components but a single core comparison. Could be tight in 30 hours if using existing weak-to-strong code.
